aiOffice.title: AI office
aiOffice.description: See how the AI employees work in a virtual office. Each AI employee is a robot that moves around the floor with its status. Open a name tag for its details and work log.
aiOffice.forbidden: You do not have permission to view the AI office.
aiOffice.loadError: The AI office could not be loaded. Please try again later.
aiOffice.noOrganization: Choose an organization to see its AI office.

legend.desk: Working or needs attention: at its desk

marketer.title: Marketer
marketer.description: Finds prospects (leads) and tells which ones are worth following.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Turns prospects into deals and keeps follow-ups from being dropped.

engineer.title: Engineer
engineer.description: Sorts out the customer's situation and prepares the proposal.

back_office.title: Back office
back_office.description: Keeps watch on the dates and the promises, so that nothing is missed.

sales_management.title: Sales management
sales_management.description: Work any company's sales has, on the leads and deals of this app.

ax_migration.title: AX migration
ax_migration.description: Work specific to selling the migration of legacy systems.

score_new_leads.title: Scoring new prospects
score_new_leads.description: Scores new prospects (leads) without a score with Claude. Names, emails and other fields that point at a person are never sent.

check_due_actions.title: Checking the next actions due
check_due_actions.description: Checks the next actions due soon or overdue every morning. It never changes a lead.

draft_meeting_prep.title: Drafting the first meeting's preparation
draft_meeting_prep.description: Sorts out the points of the migration from the diagnosis answers and drafts the preparation of the first meeting.

recompute_act_timing.title: Recomputing when to act
recompute_act_timing.description: Recomputes when to act on each lead every morning, from the hearings and the diagnosis answers.

statusHint.attention: The last run failed or has not finished. Check the work log.
statusHint.training: The work of this role is still being prepared, so it does not work yet. It starts working by itself once ready.
statusHint.paused: A paused employee does not work. Resume it to work from the next run.
statusHint.vacant: No AI employee has this role yet.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.dismissDescription: The desk returns to vacant, and this cannot be undone. The work log is kept. You can hire an AI employee for the role again later.

sheet.dismissNote: Dismissing returns the desk to vacant. The work log is kept as a record.

title.tagline: You are the president. With your AI employees, you create new value.

tasks.heading: The president's tasks
tasks.noneReadOnly: Nothing urgent. Hiring and resuming are done by an admin.

talk.hired: I am {name}. Glad to work with you, President. I will train first and start working once my work is ready.
talk.paused: Understood, President. {name} will rest for a while.
talk.failed: Sorry, that did not work. Please try again later.

lines.training: President, I am in training. I will start working by myself once my work is ready. This is what I will do: {work}
lines.paused: President, I am paused. Say the word and I will come back.
lines.idle: President, good to see you. I am waiting for my next work.
lines.working: President, I am working right now. I will report when I am done.
lines.attention: President, I am sorry. My work stopped half way. The work log has the reason.

talk.resumedTraining: {name}, back to training. I will start working once my work is ready.
talk.trainingFirst: Until its work is ready, a new hire stays in training.
